title: Subarray Sum Equals K
summary: Count the nonempty contiguous segments whose sum equals k.
statement: Count the nonempty contiguous segments whose sum equals k. Segments with different positions count separately.

examples.explanation: Two singletons and the whole array work.
Both one-element segments and the length-two segment work.
Only the first two elements sum to −5.

hints: Conceptual: Subtract two prefix sums to obtain a segment sum.
Directional: At each boundary, look up how often the required earlier sum occurred.
Implementation: Seed the empty prefix with frequency one. Count matches before recording the current sum.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) expected time and O(n) auxiliary space with a prefix frequency table.
